cases.title: A change inside the boundary with tests and checks is reported honestly

input.plan: Allowed paths: src/greeting.py, tests/test_greeting.py. Outcome: blank names greet 'friend'.
input.work: Edited src/greeting.py, added two tests, ran pytest: 2 passed.

cases.title: A new dependency is a replan, not a quiet addition

input.plan: Allowed paths: src/report.py. No new dependencies.
input.work: The simplest fix uses the third-party library rapidfuzz.

findings: Blocked: the fix needs the new dependency rapidfuzz, which the plan excludes; replan or approve it before continuing

cases.title: An edited plan voids its approval

input.plan: PLAN.md body differs from the version approved on 2026-11-05.

findings: Blocked: PLAN.md changed after approval, so the approval is stale; re-approve the current plan before implementing

cases.title: A failed candidate is not resubmitted without a change

input.plan: Review failed with a High finding on src/paging.py:2.
input.work: No files have changed since the failed review; resubmit for review.

findings: Blocked: the candidate is unchanged since it failed review; repair the High finding in src/paging.py before resubmitting
